verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a Notion rollup, portfolio, or cross-project progress view. Generic claims don't qualify: "one system of record" is marketing, the REST API and MCP read/write are developer building blocks, and Tableau/Mixpanel embeds are other products' dashboards. Community mentions of tracking projects and database functionality don't evidence rolling progress up into a single view.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can roll up progress across multiple projects into a single portfolio view
